audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart (phases[N].side) read Viktor/Viktor/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Viktor while the content layer win[N] and the packet levelChart both read Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Lissandra/Lissandra/Lissandra. Five rows rendered two different answers.
audit.why: Levels 1-5 are genuinely even: Viktor's Siphon Power (Q, 9/8/7/6/5s) shield out-trades in short exchanges from 600 range, while Lissandra's Ice Shard (Q, 725) shatters through the wave. From 6 Lissandra's point-and-click R is a hard stun that cancels Arcane Storm mid-channel (kit flags Viktor's R as an interruptible channel), which is the one thing Viktor cannot itemise around.
audit.corrected: Chart moved to Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Lissandra/Lissandra/Lissandra in the full layer, matching the content layer and the packet. Whys rewritten in the same proposal.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text named 'Prototype' upgrades and 'Perfectly Hextech' waveclear — neither exists on Viktor.
audit.why: Riot's passive is Glorious Evolution: Viktor gains Hex Fragments on kills and augments an ability per 100. Naming his spike correctly is the difference between advice a player can time and flavour text.
audit.corrected: Spikes keyed to Hex Fragment augments, Lissandra's Malignance/80s R, and Hextech Ray dropping to an 8s cooldown at rank 5.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Death Ray' and 'Chaos Storm' used throughout; the decisive interaction (Lissandra's R cancelling Viktor's channelled R) was stated only vaguely.
audit.why: Viktor's E is Hextech Ray and his R is Arcane Storm. His R is flagged as an interruptible channel; Lissandra's R is a point-and-click hard CC on a 120/100/80s cooldown, so it is a guaranteed cancel with no skillshot to dodge. Self-cast R also makes her untargetable, which dodges his Arcane Storm ticks and any burst he set up behind Gravity Field.
audit.corrected: Real names used; the R-cancels-R interaction stated explicitly on the level 6 spike, the level 6 phase why, and the late-game text.

audit.whatIsWrong: lintFindings COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT — breakdown.cooldowns held no number at all.
audit.why: The whole matchup is played around Gravity Field's window: 17s at rank 1 falling to 13s at rank 5, against Lissandra's 24s-to-12s E.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field rewritten with Gravity Field 17s/13s, Hextech Ray 12s/8s and Frozen Tomb 120s/80s.

audit.whatIsWrong: lintFindings COPY_PASTE_BLEED on dosFull[1].d (tradeGood pasted verbatim) and dontsFull[2].d (tradeBad pasted verbatim).
audit.why: Both bodies argued something other than their titles.
audit.corrected: Both bodies rewritten to match their titles, grounded in E's 24s and R's 120s.

Not asserted (kit is silent): whether Gravity Field's stun is cleansable/tenacity-reduced, and whether Lissandra's self-R untargetability drops Arcane Storm's tracking.
